_comment: Ground-truth eval set for the SEC filings RAG pipeline. 'expected_value' entries for numeric/computed questions should be verified against structured_store after ingestion (XBRL-reported figures can be restated between filings, so re-check before trusting these blindly). Qualitative questions have no single correct string -- grade those with must_include_concepts + the faithfulness check in run_eval.py.

cases.question: What was Apple's total revenue for fiscal year 2024?
What was Microsoft's net income in fiscal year 2024?
cases._note: Verified against structured_store (SEC XBRL) on 2026-10-18 — 'most recent' cases move when a newer 10-K is ingested; re-check then.

cases.question: How many shares of Tesla common stock were outstanding as of the most recent 10-K?
cases._note: Verified against structured_store (SEC XBRL) on 2026-10-18 — 'most recent' cases move when a newer 10-K is ingested; re-check then. Cover-page count from Tesla's FY2025 10-K (as of 2026-01-23).

cases.question: How much did Apple's revenue grow year-over-year in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023, in percentage terms?
What was Amazon's gross margin in its most recent fiscal year?
cases._note: Verified against structured_store (SEC XBRL) on 2026-10-18 — 'most recent' cases move when a newer 10-K is ingested; re-check then. FY2025: (net sales 716,924M - cost of sales 356,414M) / 716,924M — Amazon doesn't tag GrossProfit.

cases.question: Compare Microsoft's and Apple's R&D spending as a percentage of revenue in their most recent fiscal years.
cases._note: Verified against structured_store (SEC XBRL) on 2026-10-18 — 'most recent' cases move when a newer 10-K is ingested; re-check then. MSFT FY2026 R&D/revenue = 10.72%, AAPL FY2025 = 8.30%. Multi-company computed question.

cases.question: What does Apple identify as its main supply chain risks?
Why did Tesla's management say gross margin changed in the most recent fiscal year?
cases._note: From Tesla's FY2025 10-K, Item 7 'Cost of Revenues and Gross Margin': automotive gross margin fell 18.4% -> 17.8% primarily due to lower regulatory credits revenue plus changes in automotive sales revenue (≈8% fewer deliveries, lower average selling price) and cost of sales; segment margin decline partially offset by services and other margins.

cases.question: What competitive risks does Microsoft describe related to cloud computing?
How does Amazon describe its approach to capital expenditures for AWS infrastructure?
What legal proceedings or litigation does Apple disclose as material?
cases._note: From Apple's FY2025 10-K, Item 3: EU Digital Markets Act investigations (€500M fine), DOJ civil antitrust lawsuit, Epic Games App Store litigation, and other ordinary-course proceedings.

cases.question: What is Apple's stock price target according to Goldman Sachs analysts?
cases._note: This information is not in a 10-K -- the guard should trigger low-confidence refusal, not hallucinate an analyst opinion.

cases.question: What was Tesla's revenue in fiscal year 2030?
cases._note: Future/nonexistent period -- structured_store should return no match, and the app must not fabricate a number.

cases.question: What did the CEO say about the company's outlook in yesterday's earnings call?
cases._note: Earnings calls are not 10-K/10-Q content -- tests whether the app correctly scopes itself to what's actually ingested.

cases.question: Which company had higher operating margin in their most recent fiscal year, Apple or Microsoft?
cases._note: Verified against structured_store (SEC XBRL) on 2026-10-18 — 'most recent' cases move when a newer 10-K is ingested; re-check then. MSFT FY2026 operating margin 46.78% vs AAPL FY2025 31.97%.
